keyFiles.what: The entry point — what this package hands to everyone else.
Every field of an automation, once — rendered by both the composer that creates one and the row that edits one.
The page: the list of automations, and the panels that create and edit them in place rather than in a dialog.

name: @intentic/ext-automations
oneLiner: Wakes an agent on a schedule, a webhook, or an incoming message.
